items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: when I made my first legal record date with Red Allen

ctx.x: Yeah, and Red Allen -- let's see. Red had -- he was in Lou Russell's band. That's what it was -- at the Savoy Ballroom -- when I made my first legal record date with Red Allen and we did -- I think it was on Vocalian -- the Ritz Brothers, songs of their show, 'He Ain't Got Rhythm' and things like that. I forgot the titles of them because they were never too popular.
